jsonld_raw.name: FOLDABLE CAMPING KITCHEN
jsonld_raw.description:
Foldable aluminum camping kitchen with a box-style structure. Includes folding two-tier side tables, a detachable gas stove, three integrated storage compartments, and a side folding sink with a faucet connected to an electric water pump with a hose. The structure can be configured as a kitchen station or side table and features independent spaces for organizing utensils, containers, accessories, and ingredients.

Water pump:
4 W power, 5 V DC voltage
1200 mAh battery, rechargeable via USB

Gas stove:
Gas type: butane
Rated power: 2.2 kW/h (160 g/h)

Folding sink capacity: 4.8 liters.

Maximum load capacity of the platform: 10 kg.

Its foldable design makes transport and storage easy.
